resources.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
resources.description: Apply for student developer benefits and choose tools for your projects.
resources.limits: Student verification is required. Partner offers have separate terms, quotas and expiry dates; they are not all permanently free.

resources.name: JetBrains Student Pack
resources.description: Eligible students can apply for IDE licences for educational use.
resources.limits: Student verification applies. Educational licences are for non-commercial educational use. Do not assume paid courses or AI services are included.

resources.name: Azure for Students
resources.description: Eligible university students can apply for a student cloud account to practise deploying projects.
resources.limits: This is a conditional, time-limited cloud allowance, not unlimited free hosting. Check eligibility and service quotas before applying.

resources.name: AWS Educate
resources.description: Explore cloud computing through free self-paced courses and hands-on labs.
resources.limits: Registration and provider eligibility conditions apply. Educate labs are separate from a regular paid AWS account and do not make all AWS services free.

resources.name: Microsoft Learn
resources.description: Study Microsoft technologies in modules before deciding whether to pursue a certification.
resources.limits: Self-paced modules can be read for free. Certification exams, instructor-led training and your own cloud resources may cost money.

resources.name: MDN Learn Web Development
resources.description: Learn HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with reference documentation alongside the lessons.
resources.limits: This entry covers the public documentation and tutorials, not other subscription products.

resources.name: freeCodeCamp
resources.description: Learn programming through exercises and projects, completing your own work against curriculum requirements.
resources.limits: You must complete the work yourself. Progress or certificates are not a degree, professional licence or employment guarantee.

resources.name: Harvard CS50x
resources.description: Access computer science course materials and practise with problem sets and a final project.
resources.limits: The open course is free to study. Paid verification, credit and other course options are separate; this is not enrolment at Harvard.

resources.name: MIT OpenCourseWare
resources.description: Read MIT open course materials and choose lectures, assignments or videos available for each course.
resources.limits: Available materials vary by course. Open materials do not confer MIT enrolment, credit or a degree.

resources.name: The Python Tutorial
resources.description: Practise Python syntax, data structures, modules and exceptions with the official tutorial.
resources.limits: Best suited to readers with basic programming knowledge. Match the documentation version to your installed Python version.

resources.name: Pro Git
resources.description: Read the Git book online to understand commits, branches and collaboration.
resources.limits: The online book is free; printed editions and third-party services may cost money.

resources.name: Study Australia — Living and education costs
resources.description: Use official living and education cost information as a starting point for an Australian study budget.
resources.limits: The information is free, not living expenses or tuition. It does not guarantee a personal budget or visa requirements.

resources.name: Fair Work Ombudsman — Visa holders and migrants
resources.description: Find workplace rights information and official help routes for visa holders and migrants.
resources.limits: This is an information source, not individual legal advice. Workplace rights and visa work conditions need separate checks.

resources.name: Scamwatch
resources.description: Learn about common scams, warning signs and official reporting routes.
resources.limits: Information and reporting do not guarantee recovery of money. Do not put personal details or transaction evidence in public issues.

resources.name: ACCC — Consumers
resources.description: Find official explanations of consumer rights, pricing claims and problems with goods or services.
resources.limits: The public guidance is free. It does not guarantee refunds; check the appropriate agency and process for an individual dispute.

resources.name: State Library Victoria — Free Access
resources.description: Victorian residents can explore the free digital library card and electronic books, journals and newspapers.
resources.limits: Residency, verification and database licence restrictions apply. This entry covers Free Access, not paid memberships or chargeable services.

resources.name: State Library of Queensland — Membership
resources.description: Explore free membership, ebooks, newspapers and online courses; Queensland residents can check remote-access eligibility.
resources.limits: Remote electronic resources have residency and licence restrictions; some are onsite only. Check equipment, materials and other service charges separately.

resources.name: Australian Museum
resources.description: Visit the general galleries in Sydney for free and choose natural history and cultural collections to explore.
resources.limits: General admission is free; major exhibitions may charge. Transport, parking and food are not included.

resources.name: Queensland Museum Kurilpa
resources.description: Plan a free general-admission visit to the museum galleries in Brisbane.
resources.limits: SparkLab, some exhibitions and events charge admission. Check opening arrangements; not every experience is free.

resources.name: National Gallery of Victoria
resources.description: Visit general collection displays at NGV International or NGV Australia in Melbourne for free.
resources.limits: Special exhibitions may charge and some galleries may close temporarily. Check current exhibitions and access before visiting.

resources.name: SBS Learn English
resources.description: Practise English with free podcasts, videos and exercises based on everyday Australian situations, choosing a series at your level.
resources.limits: These are self-study materials, not exam preparation or a score guarantee. Difficulty varies; try an Easy series first.

resources.name: Adult Migrant English Program (AMEP)
resources.description: Eligible migrants and humanitarian entrants can access free English tuition and find a local provider through this government program.
resources.limits: This is not a universal benefit for all international students or visa holders. Confirm eligibility, arrangements and available support with the official program and provider.

resources.name: Be Connected
resources.description: Use free short courses on phones, computers, online services and safety, including approachable lessons to share with family.
resources.limits: Mainly introductory digital skills, not professional technical support. Choose lessons for your device and check registration or event requirements.

resources.name: eSafety Commissioner — Online safety
resources.description: Read public guidance on online safety, privacy, platform settings and online harms, with sections for adults, parents and young people.
resources.limits: This entry covers free public information. Reporting schemes have their own scope and conditions and do not guarantee an individual outcome. Keep private material off GitHub.

resources.name: Cyber.gov.au — Personal cyber security
resources.description: Use official personal cyber security resources to review protection for your devices, accounts and personal information.
resources.limits: The public guides are free to read. Follow instructions appropriate to your devices and services; they do not guarantee device repair or account recovery.

resources.name: State Library of New South Wales — Library card
resources.description: Apply for a free State Library NSW card; NSW residents can check access to ebooks, databases and journals from home.
resources.limits: Home eresource access is restricted to NSW residents and may require a valid NSW address. Other applicants must follow onsite collection and access rules. Check printing and other charges separately.

resources.name: City of Sydney Library
resources.description: NSW residents can join for free; interstate and international visitors can check free monthly membership. Explore borrowing and onsite internet access.
resources.limits: Visitor borrowing limits apply. Printing, replacement cards, some computer use and fabrication services can carry fees; free membership does not make every service free.

resources.name: National Gallery of Australia
resources.description: Visit collection displays and accessible gardens in Canberra for free, checking gallery and outdoor artwork access before setting out.
resources.limits: Selected major exhibitions require paid tickets and parking may cost money. Some gardens or works can close for maintenance.

resources.name: Art Gallery of South Australia
resources.description: Visit general collection displays in Adelaide for free and look for a free guided tour during your visit.
resources.limits: Some exhibitions charge admission. Free tours depend on volunteer availability and the day’s program. Transport and food are separate costs.

resources.name: Queensland Art Gallery | Gallery of Modern Art
resources.description: Explore general displays at QAG and GOMA and the Children’s Art Centre in Brisbane for free, choosing exhibitions that interest you.
resources.limits: Some exhibitions, special events and film sessions charge admission. Check the individual listing rather than assuming the full program is free.

resources.name: ACMI — The Story of the Moving Image
resources.description: Explore a free ongoing exhibition about film, television and videogames in Melbourne, including interactive experiences.
resources.limits: Free access applies to this exhibition. Check prices for other exhibitions, films and events separately; interactive facilities depend on onsite availability.

resources.name: Parliament of NSW — Public tours
resources.description: Join a free public tour in Sydney to learn about the parliamentary buildings, history and work, choosing a session from the official schedule.
resources.limits: Advance booking is recommended. Open days, public holidays and parliamentary business affect sessions; chamber and historic-room access is subject to availability.

resources.name: Parliament of Tasmania — Tours
resources.description: Join a free guided tour in Hobart to learn about Parliament House and parliamentary work, checking the sitting calendar first.
resources.limits: Access is through a guided tour, normally on non-sitting weekdays. Booking is encouraged and mandatory for groups of more than 12.

resources.name: Australian War Memorial
resources.description: Visit memorial spaces and historical galleries in Canberra for free, using the visitor map to plan your route.
resources.limits: The current visitor page says general entry does not require a ticket. Check school, group and special-program arrangements separately; some historical content may be confronting.

resources.name: National Museum of Australia
resources.description: Explore general galleries in Canberra for free to learn about Australian history and everyday life through museum collections.
resources.limits: Free general admission does not include all special exhibitions, programs, food or parking. Check current prices and access for your chosen activity.
